author: KANAZAWA Shinnosuke
synopsis: On a school trip to shinobi-themed Ninjatown, a young man named Ichi Kuno accidentally springs a mystical ninja trap which sends him back to the Age of the Ninja. Having no other path, he must pose as a girl and infiltrate Kurenai Academy, a school of kunoichi students, to retrieve a mystical scroll that can return him to the future. But when everyone around him is already far better at stealth and infiltration than he could ever imagine being, it’s not going to be easy. He’ll need to employ his own special bag of tricks, and have a lot of luck, if he’s going to last more than 5 Dalam perjalanan study tour sekolahnya ke Ninjatown bertema shinobi, seorang pemuda bernama Ichi Kuno secara tidak sengaja menemukan jebakan ninja mistik yang mengirimnya kembali ke Jaman dari Ninja. Tidak memiliki jalan lain, dia harus berpura-pura sebagai seorang gadis dan menyusup ke Akademi Kurenai, sebuah sekolah siswi kunoichi, untuk mengambil gulungan mistis yang bisa mengembalikannya ke masa depan.minutes sur…
